full_inspection: All four native halves were read completely and compared line by line, including all formula glyphs, doubtful letters, margin marks and the full circle/connector relocation. Enlarged detail crops confirm the hand marks and preserve their unresolved sign readings. All handwritten loci and transcription discrepancies are recorded.
original_transcription_comparison: Compared both complete original source strings. Copy2 adds two uncertain signs and a move mark, flags the trcuve/trouve doubt and has its own archive number. The original hand-underlined Q classification shared by both originals is corrected independently against both scans.

entries.decision: retain the uncertain handwritten sign without supplying an underlying quote
entries.reason: Copy2 has a thick small sign at this position; copy1 has only the intervening space. The shape does not resolve the asterisk identification or a hidden prior character.

entries.decision: retain the uncertain crossed/star-like margin sign
entries.reason: A thick crossed hand mark occurs only in copy2 right margin; its exact conventional sign remains uncertain.

entries.decision: retain the shared c/o uncertainty in both checked copies
entries.reason: Direct comparison shows the same open third-letter impression; original copy1 plain trouve was more definite than the ink permits.

entries.decision: correct copy2 original hand-underlined Q to the typed special Q
entries.reason: Both copies show the same oval, internal upright and low curved terminal of the repeated typed glyph.

entries.copy1_reading:
Par suite,
toutes les surfaces obtenues dans ce jeu par assemblage
entries.copy2_reading:
Par suite,\inserted{dans ce jeu}
toutes les surfaces obtenues dans ce jeu par assemblage
entries.decision: retain the copy2 relocation as its own revision; keep the copy1 word order in the base
entries.reason: A hand oval surrounds the existing typed words and a hand connector reaches after Par suite,. The words are not struck through; the inserted encoding records the destination, with the source comment documenting the actual move mark.

entries.decision: retain both archive numbers without author attribution
entries.reason: Both lower-left hand numerals are clear.
